How can I win a UD gift?

You may win UD gifts if you use the “How I feel” function of the app. Each “How I feel” feedback is recorded in the app and depending on their number, you may reach different levels. If you indicated your mood 150 times, you get a gift which you can collect at the Event Coordination and Alumni Centre (Egyetem tér Campus, Main building, Ground floor 17). When you start the app, you can tell us how you feel that day. To do so, select the smiley reflecting your mood. In exchange, you get a gift from us, which may be a quotation, a song or a video. Don’t worry, we won’t misuse your data. If you think that you don’t need this option, click on Information and switch this function off in the Settings.
